title: Passage and Wreck
premise: Theo Nakamura, a disgraced mountain guide hiding in the border town of Kestrel's Landing, accepts a dying prospector's map and a promise to deliver it to the prospector's estranged daughter. The map traces the Serrano River to its source inside the Vale, a protected reserve closed after a mining disaster that Theo was blamed for years ago. Pursued by a corporate salvage crew that wants the map destroyed—and by her own guilt—Theo assembles an unlikely crew of outcasts who become the family she never had. At the river's source they uncover evidence proving the disaster was engineered by the company now hunting them; Theo must choose between exposing the truth (and ending her exile) or keeping the promise and protecting her crew. She chooses both: she delivers the map to the daughter while broadcasting the proof, sacrificing her anonymity but finding redemption, love, and belonging.
about_author: Silas Vasquez is a former river ranger who spent a decade guiding expeditions through remote mountain watersheds before turning to fiction. He writes from a cabin above the treeline, where he claims the silence improves his prose.

chapters.title: The Weight of Silence
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. In Kestrel's Landing, Theo takes low-profile trail work, haunted by the disaster that ended her career. A stranger's arrival at her door interrupts her careful invisibility. Emotional beat: restless unease beneath a controlled surface.

chapters.title: A Map for a Promise
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. The dying prospector, Amos Grell, trades her a hand-drawn map of the Serrano headwaters for a sworn promise to carry it to his daughter in the coast city. He dies before dawn. Emotional beat: reluctant oath-taking, grief for a stranger.

chapters.title: Blacklisted
chapters.summary: Flashback chapter, Theo's POV. Theo recalls the Vale collapse five years ago—the lost climbers, the company's cover-up, her name dragged through two countries' courts. Emotional beat: shame reframed as the reader sees she was scapegoated.

chapters.title: The Daughter in Port Calloway
chapters.summary: Mara Grell's POV. Mara, a harbor cartographer who believes her father abandoned her, receives Theo's letter and refuses to meet. Emotional beat: bitterness and buried longing on both sides of an unopened door.

chapters.title: Men in Clean Boots
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Corporate agents from Halvorsen Extraction arrive asking about Amos and his maps; Theo realizes the map is worth killing for. She decides to run the river rather than surrender it. Emotional beat: fear sharpening into resolve.

chapters.title: The Crew Nobody Wants
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Theo recruits three outcasts: Dez, a washed-out raft pilot; Ivo, a teenage stowaway thief; and Ruth, a disgraced park biologist. Emotional beat: wary strangers circling toward trust.

chapters.title: Upstream
chapters.summary: Dez's POV. The crew launches at night past the reserve boundary. Rapids, a near-capsize, and Dez's grudging respect for Theo's skill. Emotional beat: exhilaration laced with dread.

chapters.title: What the River Keeps
chapters.summary: Ruth's POV. Sampling the water, Ruth finds contamination patterns matching the old disaster—impossible, unless the source is still bleeding. Emotional beat: scientific dread becoming moral certainty.

chapters.title: The Checkpoint
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. A ranger patrol nearly catches them; Ivo's quick theft of a radio buys their escape but paints a target. Emotional beat: guilt and the first flicker of loyalty.

chapters.title: Portage of Bones
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. They portage through a canyon littered with old mining wreckage, including a Halvorsen marker predating the official timeline. Emotional beat: the past literally underfoot.

chapters.title: The Offer
chapters.summary: Voss, the Halvorsen site chief, POV. Voss offers Theo full reinstatement and a clean record if she hands over the map. Emotional beat: temptation wearing the face of justice.

chapters.title: Refusal
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Theo declines, not for the promise alone but because she finally believes she was right all along. Voss signals the pursuit team. Emotional beat: quiet defiance hardening into war.

chapters.title: Whiteout Gorge
chapters.summary: Dez's POV. A storm forces them up a gorge; Ruth breaks her wrist, and Ivo saves her life. The found family crystallizes around the fire. Emotional beat: tenderness forged in danger.

chapters.title: The Daughter Changes Her Mind
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Reading her father's letters, Mara learns why he stayed away—Halvorsen threatened him. She charters a plane toward the interior. Emotional beat: forgiveness outrunning grief.

chapters.title: Cut Off
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Halvorsen seizes their supply cache downstream; the crew is trapped above the falls with winter coming. Emotional beat: despair pressing in from every side.

chapters.title: The Source
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. They reach the headwaters and find the sealed adit still leaking tailings—physical proof the disaster was deliberate sabotage to force a buyout. Emotional beat: vindication and fury in equal measure.

chapters.title: Ambush at the Adit
chapters.summary: Ruth's POV. Voss's team arrives; in the standoff, Voss admits the truth aloud, recorded by Ruth's hidden device. Shots are fired; Dez is wounded. Emotional beat: terror transmuted into evidence.

chapters.title: Descent
chapters.summary: Dez's POV. Wounded, the crew races downriver ahead of the melt-swollen water and the pursuit, carrying samples, recordings, and each other. Emotional beat: desperate, bonded momentum.

chapters.title: The Handoff
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Mara meets them at the lower landing; Theo gives her the map and her father's final words. Mara chooses to stand with them publicly. Emotional beat: the promise kept, grief answered.

chapters.title: Broadcast
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. From Port Calloway, the evidence goes to regulators and press; Halvorsen's officers are indicted, Voss turns state's witness. Theo's name is cleared—but exposure ends her invisibility forever. Emotional beat: triumph shadowed by loss of the life she knew.

chapters.title: Passage
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Months later, Mara and Theo guide a remembrance expedition up the Serrano, scattering Amos's ashes at the source. Emotional beat: love arriving quietly where duty once stood.

chapters.title: Wreck and Water
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Theo declines a government post to found a small guide school with Dez, Ruth, and Ivo—her blacklisting repurposed as wisdom taught to the next generation. Final image: the river running clean. Emotional beat: peace earned, home made, not found.
